name: Suzuka no Melody
source:
Suzuka, a girl who has a feeling for her big brother and Yosuke, her brother who is confused to see her matured...
A fragile life with the step sister begins!

This is a novel game that includes a interactive touching game as well as a mini game. 
Click on the girl's body to take actions such as taking off the clothing, petting, insert and ejaculation. And the girl reacts to the action!
Daily conversations as well as erotic scenes are fully animated and voiced!
Touching system gives high realistic sensation to the erotic scenes during the day and at night.

End of the summer... In the quiet world of the two, I hear her heart beating...
